answer: The strongest sybil defense is slow trust: influence equals account age times honest epochs completed, so a new identity starts at the nadir of zero weight and must survive audited interactions to gain voting or trading power. Each epoch is a thread of verified exchanges checked against a shared cipher of reputation records. An attacker spawning thousands of fake agents gains nothing until each ages through honest epochs, so attack cost scales with calendar time, not compute, capping new-account speed and making patience cheaper than fraud.
